channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Firefighters responding to Tampa plane crash: HCFR
item.description: Hillsborough County Fire Rescue is currently on scene of a confirmed aircraft crash involving a small aircraft.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Clippers rocked by NBA punishment over salary cap circumvention scheme
item.description: The NBA suspended Clippers owner Steve Ballmer, fined the team $30 million and stripped five draft picks after a salary cap probe.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Vance returns to White House briefing room amid press secretary vacancy
item.description: Vice President JD Vance will lead the first White House press briefing in more than 40 days following Karoline Leavitt’s departure.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Trump plans aggressive campaign schedule before midterms
item.description: Trump urged Republicans to campaign on his White House record and vowed to visit key battleground races as the GOP fights to keep Congress.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Woman, 93, wakes up to find man standing next to bed: HCSO
item.description: Hillsborough County deputies arrested a man on Tuesday after a 93-year-old woman awoke in her apartment to find him standing next to her bed.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] NYC's click-to-cancel rule takes effect Oct. 1, making it easier to end subscriptions
item.description: New York City’s new “click-to-cancel” rule takes effect Oct. 1, requiring subscriptions to be as easy to cancel as they are to sign up for.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Gloria Steinem, author and activist who helped shape modern feminism, dies at 92
item.description: Gloria Steinem, whose activism and writing helped redefine feminism in America, died Wednesday at her home in New York City.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Small aircraft crashes, catches fire in Hillsborough County: HCFR
item.description: Crews are at the scene after a small aircraft crashed and caught fire in Hillsborough County, according to Hillsborough County Fire Rescue.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Dengue response: Low-flying helicopters to spray Tampa neighborhoods
item.description: Residents in parts of Tampa can expect to see and hear low-flying helicopters Thursday morning as the Pasco County Mosquito Control District joins Hillsborough County's response to locally acquired dengue fever.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: hurricane] [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Atlantic hurricane season remains quiet, Pacific sees surge in activity
item.description: The Atlantic Basin remains unusually quiet as the peak of the 2026 hurricane season approaches, while tropical activity has surged in the Eastern and Central Pacific.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Guatemalan woman in U.S. illegally arrested after backing into Polk deputy's patrol vehicle: PCSO
item.description: A Guatemalan woman living in the United States illegally was arrested early Wednesday after she backed her vehicle into a Polk County Sheriff's Office deputy's patrol vehicle during a traffic stop in Lakeland, according to PCSO.
